Definition: feminine from the same as G3551; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X eat, pasture.
BiblicalUsage: Pasture is the feeding ground, and the same word names the feeding of a sore. Jesus says the sheep that enters by Him shall go in and out and find pasture, while Paul warns that the word of Hymenaeus and Philetus eats as a canker spreads — one pasture feeds, the other devours.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two pastures show the two shepherds: Christ's pasture feeds the sheep, and false teaching feeds on them.
